subject: Post-demo follow-up: MedScope breach-notification packet & SOC 2 artifacts
messages:
From: Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@medscope.io>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medscope.io
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0500
Subject: Follow-up from demo — breach-notif timelines & SOC 2 status

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the demo earlier — the team found the routing/fallback story compelling. A few items came up during our security sync that we need to nail down before we proceed to procurement and legal:

- SOC 2 status: do you have the most recent attestation or a short summary we can share with our compliance team?
- Incident response / breach notification timelines: if a data breach affecting MedScope data were to occur, what's Redwood's notification SLA (initial contact, detailed report)? Please call out GDPR vs HIPAA timelines if they differ.
- BCP / DR evidence: can you provide an overview (RTO/RPO targets, runbook excerpt, escalation contacts) or a sample doc we can review?

We know some of this is sensitive — if you prefer a secure upload or signed NDA we can do that. For now, a short packet or pointers to the specific artifacts will help accelerate our internal risk review.

Next steps from our side: legal will want the packet by the end of next week (Dec 28) to stay on track for our Q1 rollout. Can you confirm whether Redwood can meet that window?

Appreciate it,
Julia
Sr. Security & Compliance, MedScope Health
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@medscope.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 17:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo — breach-notif timelines & SOC 2 status

Hi Julia,

Great to meet you earlier — glad the demo was helpful. Thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: yes, we can provide a SOC 2 Type II summary and a compact IR/BCP packet suitable for vendor review. We can safely meet your Dec 28 target.

I've looped in Karthik (security lead — he will assemble the IR evidence) and Monica (customer success / operations — she maintains our BCP/DR extracts). Proposed next steps:

1) Karthik to share the SOC 2 summary and a redacted extract of our IR playbook (suitable for external review).
2) Monica to attach an RTO/RPO matrix and a short runbook excerpt (no privileged keys or internal-only contact details).
3) We'll upload the package to a secure Drive folder and share the link + HubSpot doc for your legal team.

If you need an NDA before any sensitive artifacts, say the word — otherwise we will provide sanitized artifacts and the SOC 2 summary now.

Olga
Director, Security & Trust Operations
Redwood Inference

--

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 09:10:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo — breach-notif timelines & SOC 2 status

Olga / Monica,

Attaching the sanitized packet for MedScope: 
- redwood_soc2_summary_2025.pdf (one-page attestation summary + controls map)
- ir-playbook-extract.txt (redacted incident runbook excerpt)
- bcp-table.xlsx (RTO/RPO and primary escalation matrix)

Key notes to pass to MedScope legal/compliance:
- SOC 2: Redwood holds a SOC 2 Type II attestation with coverage through Sep 30, 2025. The attached summary maps common vendor controls; full report available under NDA.
- Breach notification timelines: we follow regulatory timelines: GDPR-notification target is 72 hours for personal data breaches; HIPAA notifications follow the 60-day requirement where applicable. Operationally we commit to initial notification to the customer within 24 hours of confirming an incident that impacts customer data (this is our customer-facing practice; root-cause and full remediation report aim for delivery within 72 hours for most incidents, longer for complex forensic investigations).
- BCP/DR: the attached sheet lists RTO/RPO by service tier and a short list of failover steps; RTO targets vary by product tier (hosted API standard tier RTO = 4 hours, dedicated pools subject to reserved capacity SLAs).

I'll also include a runbook excerpt (redacted) and a contact list for escalation that contains our escalation roles (no phone numbers in this external packet). If MedScope needs phone-based escalation, we can arrange a signed NDA and a secure call.

Uploading now to the secure folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBz_example_secure_upload
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8142

--
Karthik Iyer
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@medscope.io>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medscope.io, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 11:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo — breach-notif timelines & SOC 2 status

Olga / Karthik / Monica —

Thanks, this is perfect and on a fast timeline — appreciate the clear callouts. I downloaded the three files and have shared them with our legal/compliance team. A few quick items from our review:

- We may ask for the full SOC 2 report under NDA for the legal review; I will confirm by EOD Monday.
- The 24-hour initial-notification practice + regulatory timelines covers our needs; please make sure the packet includes an example notification template (even redacted) for our Incident Response playbook.
- For BCP/DR: can you confirm the RTO = 4 hours applies to your hosted API only and what the RTO is for dedicated pools (we're evaluating a dedicated tier but want the numbers explicitly listed)?

Next steps: Legal to confirm NDA request by 2026-12-21; if NDA requested, we will sign and you can provide the full SOC 2 report. Otherwise, we'll proceed with the sanitized packet. We will aim to return questionnaire responses and a signed SOW to stay on the Dec 28 procurement cadence.

Best,
Julia
Sr. Security & Compliance, MedScope Health
